business_problem: RFEA had athlete records, sensor streams, biomechanics video and physiological metrics spread across disconnected systems, limiting its ability to combine insights quickly and use data as a coaching advantage.
solution_summary: RFEA partnered with IBM and Habber Tec to build IA-THLETICS on IBM watsonx.data as a modern lakehouse for performance analytics. Historical records, live wearable telemetry, high-speed video and physiological measurements are standardized into queryable tables inside a governed environment so the federation can work from one AI-ready data foundation instead of siloed systems. Coaches and analysts then access unified dashboards showing cadence, recovery and health indicators in real time, while machine-learning models use the consolidated data to detect biomechanical patterns, predict injury risk and recommend more personalized training plans. The platform is designed to support daily coaching and competition decisions rather than replace expert judgment, and it gives RFEA a scalable base for multilingual dashboards, predictive modeling and personalized training at national-team scale. In effect, watsonx.data becomes the operational backbone that turns raw athletic telemetry into evidence-based coaching.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.data
solution_components.role: Provides the lakehouse backbone that unifies athlete records, sensor data, video and physiological measurements into a governed analytics platform.

data_flow: Historical athlete records, live wearable streams, high-speed video and physiological metrics are normalized in watsonx.data, surfaced through unified dashboards and consumed by AI models that generate coaching and injury-risk insights.
business_outcome: RFEA created a national-scale evidence-based coaching platform that improves how data is used across disciplines today and establishes a strong foundation for broader AI-driven performance and injury-prevention use cases.
architecture_clues: The architecture is explicitly described as a modern data lakehouse built on watsonx.data.
IA-THLETICS already supports multiple disciplines including race walking, discus, hurdles, sprint and relay events.
